effect: The result confirms that glucose returns to the blood and adds that salts and much of the filtered water are recovered too.
reaction: The connection between removing waste and taking useful substances back was satisfying, though I wanted more explanation of how recovery works.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting circulation to the filter was most worthwhile because the result showed that useful glucose enters filtrate alongside water, salts and urea, and distinguished filtrate from finished urine.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the recovery lining was fairly predictable as the only offered action. Its result described what returns to blood but did not explain the mechanism.

surprise.text: The filter letting useful glucose leave the blood made the need for recovery clearer.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: each had a clear purpose, although the menu supplied the compatible pairs.

continue.text: I would probably continue briefly to see how the model connects kidney function to a drink, but I would want more meaningful choices or explanation of the mechanisms.
